name: date-range-text
title: Date range text
description: A date range written the way people say it: 12 to 15 March 2026, with the shared month and year said once, times, open ends and nights, in the reader's language.
docs: Built on Intl.DateTimeFormat formatRangeToParts, with a time element for each end. English reads "to"; other languages keep their own range mark, or pass separator. includeTime adds the clock, nights appends "3 nights", and a missing start or end reads "from" or "until". Pass labels for those words in another language.
